selected.name: Duration questions search profile and state memories
selected.description: When a question asks how long a person has had, owned, or possessed something (e.g., 'how long has X had Y?'), search profile and state memories as well as event memories.

Run hybrid/structured searches for the person's activities with a time filter: world_start on or after the event date; include planned future events and activity/event memory kinds.

Stop once a coherent set of post-event activities covering the question's claims is retrieved; do not keep expanding after that.

nearby_not_selected.name: Per-Subject Life-Event Search for Commonality Questions
nearby_not_selected.description: When a question asks what two named people have in common and the initial search returns mostly relationship or interaction memories, retrieve each person's individual life events for comparison.

Compare the returned individual events to find matching predicates or facts across the two people; prefer that evidence for the commonality over relationship-only memories.
Stop once an overlapping event directly answers the question, or after two targeted per-person searches per subject yield no new relevant events.
